_note: exempt_strategies: strategies in this list are NEVER scored or gated by this filter (opt-OUT, default empty - unlike regime_match/market_efficiency's opt-IN applicable_strategies, since this filter has always applied to every strategy uniformly and flipping the default would silently change behavior nobody asked to touch). sr_reversal is exempt: this filter's ATH-proximity/cup-formation checks require a near-all-time-high or bullish-base signature, which is close to the OPPOSITE of that strategy's own entry (a stock that just fell away from its highs and bounced) - see trader/filters/quality.py docstring for the full diagnosis. (range_reversion was previously exempt too but was removed from the codebase on 2026-10-24.)
